title: philotheca difformis
intro: Philotheca difformis, commonly known as the lemon-scented boxwood or lemon-scented bottlebrush, is a plant species within the Rutaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Philotheca difformis are attributed to its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
